nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development
nodes.rationale: Approved designs before non-trivial code, tracked as GitHub issues; no coding until approval

nodes.label: Three-Tier Rules Architecture
nodes.rationale: Always (50 lines) / Auto glob (150) / Agent on-demand (200); never broad globs to avoid context bloat

nodes.label: Generated contract (openapi.yaml + types)
nodes.rationale: contract-generation.ts is the single seam for watch mode and generate-spec so the committed contract is byte-identical; failure is fatal by design.

nodes.label: Regeneration workflow
nodes.rationale: If a dashboard type is stale, regenerate; never cast with as any / ts-ignore.

nodes.label: Data invariants
nodes.rationale: No stored COA balance; StockMovement immutable ledger with StockBalance projection; atomic invoice posting; cancellation via reversal; AuditLog append-only.

nodes.label: Tenant scoping convention
nodes.rationale: Every tenant-owned model has tenantId + Cascade relation + index; CrudRepository merges tenantId; IDs never assumed globally unique.

nodes.label: Invariants worth memorizing
nodes.rationale: Tenant scope mandatory; posted docs immutable; money+stock transactional; ledger is truth; contracts generated; dashboard is a client.

nodes.label: ADR-0002 Master Data Code Sequences
nodes.rationale: DocumentSequence is user-facing and document-semantic; overloading it would surface catalog counters in its UI. max(code)+1 races under concurrency.

nodes.label: ADR-0005 No Organization Level; Tenant Is the Legal Entity
nodes.norm_label: adr-0005 no organization level; tenant is the legal entity
nodes.rationale: Organization level not needed today; adding it later (organizationId on Branch + backfill) is accepted to avoid speculative modelling.

nodes.label: ADR-0006 Master Data Is Tenant-Shared
nodes.rationale: Nesting master data under Branch would duplicate it and break tenant-wide reporting; the roadmap diagram is read as workflow dependency, not ownership.

nodes.label: ADR-0007 Warehouses Are Shared Across Branches
nodes.norm_label: adr-0007 warehouses are shared across branches
nodes.rationale: Stock is physically in a warehouse, not a branch; an isPrimary flag and excluding shared warehouses were rejected because they hide stock from branches that use it.

nodes.label: ADR-0008 Tenant-Level Document Numbering
nodes.rationale: Re-constraining numbering later means renumbering history; nullable DocumentSequence.branchId is the deliberate seam for a future per-branch scheme.

nodes.label: Localized String JSONB
nodes.rationale: Stored as { ar, en? } JSONB to support multilingual display without a separate translations table; ar is the primary locale.

nodes.label: Locked Exchange Rate
nodes.rationale: Rate of document currency to tenant base currency locked at posting time (Decimal 18,6).

nodes.label: Reversing Journal Entry
nodes.rationale: Cancellation posts a reversing entry rather than deleting, preserving ledger integrity.
